system.notes: Plasteel exoskeleton pressurized to 1 atmosphere: dives to 600 m with no decompression risk, 20 hours of self-contained air. Armor Rating 6. The suit has Strength 7; each extra point (to a maximum of 10) costs +5,000¥. The wearer takes −2 Quickness and Reaction and rolls only one Initiative die — apply by hand. Modified for a rigger interface, those penalties vanish, it works as a vehicle control rig, and a jacked rigger uses the Control Pool in place of the Combat Pool. Cyberpirates p.173.
